article.title: -(으)므로 causa formal
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The NIKL guide defines **-(으)므로** as expressing a reason or basis, especially in formal and written contexts. It documents examples where the following clause is a command or proposal, unlike **-기 때문에**. This entry is limited to that register and clause-type contrast.
